title: Stand inside the care already holding you
summary: The Creator's mercy holds more firmly than fear's predictions. Return the breath before fear writes the day.
takeaway: Return the breath before fear writes the day.
lifeApplication: When the mind starts outrunning the day, pause at the doorway, the screen, or the sink and return to one line before planning again.

source.shortMeaning: The Creator's mercy holds more firmly than fear's predictions.
source.lifeApplication: When fear grips the body, name the care already holding you.

evidence.coreClaim: The Creator's mercy holds more firmly than fear's predictions.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: the Creator's mercy is steadier than your wavering.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind starts outrunning the day, pause at the doorway, the screen, or the sink and return to one line before planning again.
